title: Viral Chromosome Conformation Capture (V3C) Assays for Identifying Trans-interaction Sites
author: Kinjal Majumder
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Parasynchronize and infect cells
steps.instruction: Plate 5 × 10⁶ cells at 0.5 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹ in 10 ml Isoleucine‑minus media in 15 cm dishes and incubate 36–42 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Aspirate media, add 10 ml complete DMEM to release cells into G1/S‑phase, and simultaneously add 25 µl MVMp (1 × 10⁶ PFU µl⁻¹) to achieve an MOI of 5; incubate 16 h. Note that MVMp replication begins ~10 h after release.

steps.title: Crosslink cells and collect nuclei
steps.instruction: Add 540 µl 37 % formaldehyde (final 2 %) to each dish, mix, and rock 10 min at room temperature (12 oscillations min⁻¹). Quench with 1.425 ml 1 M glycine (final 0.125 M), mix, and rock 5 min. Scrape cells horizontally and vertically with a disposable scraper, collect the 12 ml suspension into a 15 ml Falcon tube, and centrifuge 500 × g 5 min at 4 °C. Aspirate supernatant (vacuum manifold preferred), wash pellet with 10 ml PBS, centrifuge again 500 × g 5 min at 4 °C, and aspirate. Resuspend pellet in 5 ml cold 3C Lysis buffer (supplemented with protease inhibitors), incubate on ice 10 min, then centrifuge 3 000 × g 5 min at 4 °C. Aspirate supernatant; the white nuclear pellet may be snap‑frozen in liquid N₂ and stored at –80 °C (or thaw on ice if starting from frozen).

steps.title: Primary restriction digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in 500 µl 1.2× NEB Buffer 2.1 (60 µl 10× stock + 440 µl ddH₂O). Add 7.5 µl 20 % SDS (final 0.3 %) and shake 37 °C, 900 rpm for 1 h. Add 50 µl 20 % Triton X‑100 (final 2 %) and shake 37 °C, 900 rpm for another hour. Remove 10 µl as an undigested gDNA control and store –20 °C. Add 20 µl Hin dIII (400 U) and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 900 rpm. Add a further 15 µl Hin dIII (300 U) and incubate 4 h at 37 °C, 900 rpm. Remove 10 µl as a digested DNA control and store –20 °C.

steps.title: Reverse crosslinks and assess digestion
steps.instruction: To each control tube add 2 µl Proteinase K and incubate 56 °C for 1 h. Dilute to 100 µl with 90 µl ddH₂O, add 100 µl phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), vortex 10 s (setting 10), and centrifuge 13 000 × g at room temperature for 5 min. Transfer supernatant, add 1 ml isopropanol and 2 µl glycogen, vortex 10 s, centrifuge 13 000 × g RT 5 min, aspirate supernatant, add 1 ml 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 13 000 × g RT 5 min, aspirate, and resuspend pellet in 20 µl Buffer EB. Perform qPCR with Bio‑Rad SYBR Green Supermix (annealing 60 °C) using 2 µl undigested or digested template and primer sets P1‑P2 (Input) and P1‑P3 (Undigested); run each reaction in triplicate. Calculate digestion efficiency with Percent digestion = (1 – 2^(Cq P1‑P2 – Cq P1‑P3)) × 100.

steps.title: Ligate digested chromatin
steps.instruction: Add 40 µl 20 % SDS (final 1.6 %) to the digested chromatin and incubate 20–25 min at 65 °C. Transfer nuclei to a 50 ml Falcon tube, add 6.125 ml 1.15× ligation buffer (10× diluted in ddH₂O) and 375 µl 20 % Triton X‑100 (final 1 %). Incubate 1 h at 37 °C with gentle shaking. Add 1 µl T4 DNA ligase (100 U total) and incubate 4 h at room temperature (or 16 °C). Add 15 µl 20 mg ml⁻¹ Proteinase K (final 300 µg) and incubate overnight at 65 °C (56 °C also acceptable).

steps.title: Purify DNA
steps.instruction: Add 10 µl 10 mg ml⁻¹ RNase A (final 100 µg) and incubate 30–45 min at 37 °C. Add 7 ml phenol‑chloroform, vortex, centrifuge 5 min at 2 000 × g, 4 °C; transfer aqueous phase, add 7 ml chloroform, vortex, centrifuge 5 min at 2 000 × g, 4 °C; transfer supernatant to a 50 ml tube, add 25 ml isopropanol and 5 µl glycogen (10 mg ml⁻¹), mix, and place at –80 °C for 1 h. Centrifuge 20 min at 4 200 × g at room temperature, discard supernatant, add 10 ml 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 15 min at 4 200 × g, 4 °C, discard supernatant, air‑dry pellet, and dissolve DNA in 200 µl Buffer EB.

steps.title: Secondary restriction digestion
steps.instruction: Set up an Nla III digest of the entire 3C DNA with 25 µl 10× Cutsmart buffer and 15 µl Nla III; incubate overnight at 37 °C. Inactivate Nla III at 65 °C for 20 min. Add 250 µl 1× phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol, vortex, spin 10 000 × g, collect supernatant; add 250 µl chloroform, vortex, spin 10 000 × g, collect supernatant. Precipitate DNA with 700 µl isopropanol and 2 µl glycogen (10 mg ml⁻¹), vortex, spin 10 000 × g, aspirate, wash with 1 ml 70 % ethanol, spin 10 000 × g, aspirate, and resuspend the pellet in 1 ml ultrapure water.

steps.title: Circularize DNA
steps.instruction: In a 50 ml Falcon tube combine 1.5 ml 10× ligase buffer, 12.5 ml water, 1 ml Nla III‑digested DNA, and 1 µl T4 DNA ligase; incubate overnight. Add 15 ml phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol, vortex, spin 4 200 × g, collect supernatant; add 15 ml chloroform, vortex, spin 4 200 × g, collect supernatant. Precipitate with 25 ml isopropanol and 5 µl glycogen (10 mg ml⁻¹), spin 4 200 × g, wash with 10 ml 70 % ethanol, spin 4 200 × g, aspirate, air‑dry 20 min at room temperature, and resuspend in 200 µl Buffer EB. Purify using a QIAGEN PCR purification kit, eluting twice in 100 µl Buffer EB.

steps.title: Inverse PCR and library prep
steps.instruction: Quantify V3C‑seq product by Nanodrop and use 200–600 ng template per reaction. Set up inverse PCR with Platinum Taq High‑Fidelity: 2 µl template, 2.5 µl 10× PCR buffer, 1 µl MgSO₄, 0.5 µl dNTP mix, 0.5 µl Primer 1, 0.5 µl Primer 2, 0.1 µl HiFi Taq, and 17.9 µl ddH₂O. PCR program: 94 °C 2 min; 68 °C 10 min; hold 4 °C. Dilute product 1:100 in TE buffer, then perform nested inverse PCR using the diluted product as template. Purify nested PCR product with a QIAGEN PCR purification kit (elute in 50 µl Buffer EB), measure concentration by Nanodrop, and prepare sequencing libraries with the NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina. Pool up to 12 libraries per lane and sequence on an Illumina NextSeq 500.

steps.title: Prepare TE buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0) with 1 mM EDTA (pH 8.0) to make TE buffer.

steps.title: Prepare complete DMEM media
steps.instruction: Combine 500 ml DMEM (with L‑glutamine), add 5 % fetal calf serum, and supplement with 500 µl Gentamicin (50 mg ml⁻¹) to obtain complete DMEM media.

steps.title: Prepare 3C lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 7.5), 10 mM NaCl, and 0.2 % NP40 in water to make 3C lysis buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Isoleucine‑minus media
steps.instruction: In a sterile container add ~350 ml ddH₂O, 50 ml Earle’s 10× salts (see recipe), then 0.5 ml each of 1,000× stock L‑arginine, L‑cysteine, L‑histidine, L‑leucine, L‑lysine, L‑methionine, L‑phenylalanine, L‑threonine, L‑tryptophan, L‑tyrosine, and L‑valine. Add 600 µl 100× vitamins, 5 ml Gentamicin, and 1 M HEPES (pH 7.5). Adjust pH to red using 7.5 % sodium bicarbonate, bring final volume to 475 ml with ddH₂O, filter through a 0.22 µm membrane, sterilize, dialyze against 5 % serum, and store at 4 °C.
